id.description: The persisted Port OS route identifier. Synchronized routes can receive a backend-generated, owner-scoped value here even when the discovery payload supplied an explicit route `id`; do not use this field as the stable plugin-owned route identity unless the synchronizing implementation explicitly documents preservation.

associatedPluginId.description: The ID of the associated plugin

associatedPluginRouteId.description: The stable plugin-owned route identifier associated with this Port OS route. For synchronized plugin capability contracts and fixture parity checks, use this field to match a route from enumeration back to the discovery payload.

externalId.description: The external ID of the route given by the reporting system

associatedAuthLinkId.description: The ID of the associated auth link

associatedEndpointId.description: The ID of the associated endpoint

name.description: The name of the route as a human readable string or a localizable asset. This is either a raw string or a localizable asset reference.

interfaces.description: List of interfaces supported by the route. These denote what the route is capable of performing such as turning off/on, etc.

ontologicalTypes.description: List of ontological types for the route. These are used mostly for customers to know what an endpoint is, like if its a lightbulb, or a speaker, etc.

pluginCustomMetadata.description: A set of custom metadata that the plugin uses and attaches to the route, this is meant specifically for the plugin to use.

description.description: The description of the route as a human readable string or a localizable asset.

manufacturer.description: The manufacturer of the route as a human readable string or a localizable asset.

model.description: The model of the route as a human readable string or a localizable asset.

serialNumber.description: The serial number of the route as a human readable string or a localizable asset.
